nodes.label: F10: QR Format FNG2 with ECDSA P-256 Signature
nodes.norm_label: f10: qr format fng2 with ecdsa p-256 signature
nodes.rationale: PHP openssl_sign produces DER but browser WebCrypto only accepts raw r-s (IEEE P1363), so DER must be converted before encoding; the private key never leaves the server.

nodes.label: F11: Pass Usage inside_count <= people
nodes.rationale: Each check-in increments the count; manager overrides are flagged for audit.

nodes.label: F12: Check-in Idempotent per client_uuid
nodes.rationale: Offline door devices queue check-ins and sync later; if syncing pushes inside_count over people (two offline devices scanning the same pass), the server accepts and marks conflict=true because the person is already physically inside.

nodes.label: F14: Minimal Personal Data, Phone Last 4 Digits Only
nodes.norm_label: f14: minimal personal data, phone last 4 digits only
nodes.rationale: List endpoints for door and admin only ever send the last 4 digits of phone; the full number never appears in list responses.

nodes.label: F17: Manual Entry Code (Crockford Base32)
nodes.rationale: 8-character code excluding I, L, O, U, shown as XXXX-XXXX, used when camera or scanner fails; normalized (uppercase, strip spaces/hyphens, O to 0, I/L to 1) before matching; manifest carries only entry_code_hash (SHA-256), never the code itself; 10 wrong attempts per minute locks input for 60 seconds.

nodes.rationale: Per-person quota counted inside a transaction with a row lock on the event to prevent overbooking under concurrent signups; one active signup per phone per night.

nodes.label: F9: Guestlist QR Modes group/personal
nodes.rationale: group mode issues one pass for N people; personal mode issues N named passes, trading convenience for individual accountability.

nodes.label: F4: One Table, One Active Booking Per Night
nodes.norm_label: f4: one table, one active booking per night
nodes.rationale: Enforced via a virtual unique DB column (active_table_id), not only application code, to guarantee correctness under concurrency.

nodes.label: F5: Hold 15 Minutes, Invoice 14 Minutes
nodes.rationale: Booking held 900s but Xendit invoice_duration=840s so the invoice always dies one minute before the table releases, preventing payment landing on a table already given to someone else.

nodes.label: F6: Deposit 50% of Minimum Spend, Forfeited
nodes.norm_label: f6: deposit 50% of minimum spend, forfeited
nodes.rationale: Deposit is non-refundable on cancel or no-show; no refund endpoint exists, simplifying money flow for a portfolio demo.

nodes.label: F7: Xendit Webhook Never Creates Records
nodes.norm_label: f7: xendit webhook never creates records
nodes.rationale: Must match x-callback-token before touching the database, match invoice id and external_id to an existing booking, and process idempotently per (invoice, status) pair.

nodes.label: Webhook Verification Order Pattern
nodes.rationale: Token check with hash_equals happens before any DB query so a forged webhook cannot touch the database; matching both invoice id and external_id prevents cross-booking spoofing.

nodes.label: Xendit Invoice Hold Pattern (no SDK)
nodes.rationale: No Xendit SDK used: only two HTTP calls are needed (create invoice, read invoice), so Laravel's HTTP client is enough and one fewer dependency needs maintenance.

nodes.label: Design Authority Order (Contract > PRD+mockup > skill)
nodes.rationale: Contract (Document 0) beats PRD+mockup beats skill suggestions; when a skill suggests something different from an already-approved mockup, the mockup wins, keeping design decisions stable against tool suggestions.

nodes.label: Visual Rules (font-weight, em dash, contrast)
nodes.rationale: Poiret One and Didact Gothic only have one weight and no italic, so emphasis must come from color instead of font-weight or italics; keeps the UI legible and on-brand across every screen.
